description: This PHP source file defines the HomeController class within the Installer module of the OrangeHRM system. The class extends an abstract controller and handles routing logic, specifically redirecting users based on installation status.

classes.name: HomeController
classes.description: Controller handling the homepage logistics during installation, extending AbstractInstallerController and providing redirect logic based on installation status.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes routing logic; redirects to main app if installed, otherwise redirects to welcome page.
